notes.title: Saving You From Yourself - Part 2 is now available on Steam + New Translation!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's been a few years.

Saving You From Yourself has now been remade in Godot.

I've added for the first time the short film "Saving You From Yourself - Part 2" into the game that fleshes out the work.

You can access this scene after rejecting hormones three times.

The game is available in Japanese for the first time ever. Once again the translation was done by Fuglekongerige.

Thank you for reading this update,

Taylor McCue

notes.title: He Fucked The Girl Out of Me is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thank you for playing [i]Saving You, From Yourself[/i].

I’ve released a new game on steam, it’s titled: [i]He Fucked The Girl Out of Me[/i] or [i]HFTGOOM[/i] for short.

The game is a semi-fictionalized autobiographical visual novel for gameboy color about my experiences with trauma and sex work. HFTGOOM takes approximately 45 minutes to play through from start to finish.

You can play it here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293660/He_Fucked_The_Girl_Out_of_Me/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293660/He_Fucked_The_Girl_Out_of_Me/[/url]

Trigger warnings are both in game and on the store description. [b]The game is 18+ only.[/b]

I cannot say the game is for everyone but I hope that you will consider playing it.

Thank you,

Taylor McCue
